hostname.description: Linux hostname. Source of truth is this object, not /etc/hostname.

power.description: run is steady state. reboot and halt require --confirm on apply.

env.description: Process environment PID 1 injects into svc spawn and login. Catalog is truth; /etc/profile is a side effect.

timezone.description: Display TZ (POSIX). Empty is UTC. Seat svcs get TZ=; not env, not /etc/localtime.
